IMessageButton.label: Text Zoey in Messages
IMessageButton.smsBody: Hi — help me build a simple skincare routine.

story.heading: Less guessing. More calm, consistent skin days.
story.subtitle: Ask a question, send a photo, or say what you used. Zoey turns the mess into one clear next step.

snapOrText.heading: A routine simple enough to stick with.
snapOrText.body: Focus on the few products your skin actually needs, so you can stop restarting every week and start noticing what works.
snapOrText.point1: She describes visible details cautiously and avoids diagnosis.
snapOrText.point2: When a product should be remembered, she asks before saving it.

smartReminders.heading: Gentle support when life gets busy.
smartReminders.body: Get a helpful nudge when you want one. Miss a night and simply pick up where you left off—no streaks, pressure, or guilt.
smartReminders.point1: No invented morning or evening reminder defaults.
smartReminders.point2: One-off follow-ups and recurring reminders stay separate.

dailySummaries.heading: Try new products with a clear plan.
dailySummaries.body: Send a product or skin photo and learn where it fits, what to watch for, and whether now is the right time to add it.
dailySummaries.point1: Routine status comes from verified logs, not guesses from chat.
dailySummaries.point2: Export and delete paths are part of the same data story.

Faq.heading: A few useful answers
Faq.a1: No. Zoey is an AI skincare coach. She can describe visible features cautiously, explain product labels, and suggest practical routine steps, but she does not diagnose or replace a clinician.
Faq.q2: What do I need to get started?
Faq.a2: Just an iPhone with iMessage. No app to download, no account to create. Text Zoey and set up your routine in a short chat.
Faq.a3: Only context that makes future help more useful, such as your routine, goals, products, and reactions. Zoey asks before saving sensitive details, and you can ask what she remembers or delete it.
Faq.q4: How does the free trial work?
Faq.a4: You get full access during the trial period. Track routines, remember products, set reminders, and review summaries. No credit card required to start.
Faq.a5: Zoey detects your language from your message and responds accordingly. English and Swedish are supported, with more languages coming soon.

Privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Zoey ("Zoey", "we", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.body:
When you use Zoey, we collect:

• Your phone number (to identify your account and deliver messages via iMessage)
• Your confirmation that you are at least 16 during setup, never your exact age or birthdate
• Your name, communication style, skin goals, skin type if shared, sensitivities, allergies, current products, and one-variable skincare experiments in agent memory
• Routine updates and logs, reminders, timezone, and country for localization
• Sanitized conversation history, which stores text and a generic marker for photo turns but not image bytes or private image URLs

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.body:
We use your data to:

• Provide skincare routine tracking and product guidance
• Remember your chosen communication style and relevant routine context
• Track one-variable skincare experiments and optional review reminders
• Generate routine summaries, adherence recaps, and reminders
• Process product labels and skin photos for the current reply
• Communicate with you via iMessage

dataStorage.title: Data Storage & Security
dataStorage.body: Connections to our website and services use TLS (HTTPS). Your phone number is encrypted at rest using AES. Routine log content and onboarding data during setup are stored as encrypted application-layer payloads. Agent memory, message history, and operational account fields are stored with strict access controls. Photos are processed for the current reply by default and are not added to conversation history. Users may separately opt into encrypted private photo retention for 30 days.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body:
We use the following third-party services to operate Zoey:

• OpenAI — for image analysis and natural language processing
• Sendblue — for iMessage delivery

These services process data as necessary to provide our features. We do not sell your data to third parties.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: We retain agent memory, routine logs, reminders, account data, and sanitized conversation history while your account is active. Photos retained with separate consent expire after 30 days. Turning off photo retention affects future photos; saved photos can be deleted separately. Deleting saved photos does not remove text derived from earlier photo discussions; deleting the account removes both.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body:
You have the right to:

• Ask what Zoey remembers and request a copy of your data
• Correct or forget profile, product, and experiment details in agent memory
• Enable or disable future photo retention, and delete saved photos
• Request deletion of your account, including agent memory and privacy preferences
• Withdraw consent at any time

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about this privacy policy, contact us at privacy@skintext.ai.

Terms.heading: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: By using Zoey ("Zoey", "the Service"), you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be at least 16 years old and have access to an iPhone with iMessage to use Zoey. We ask only whether you are 16 or older, not for your exact age or birthdate.

service.title: The Service
service.body: Zoey is an AI-powered skincare routine assistant that operates through iMessage. The service includes routine logging, product notes, communication preferences, one-variable skincare experiments, summaries, adherence recaps, reminders, transient photo processing, and chat-based memory controls. Photo retention is optional and requires separate consent.

accuracy.title: Skincare Guidance
accuracy.body: Zoey provides routine support and conservative product guidance based on what you share. She does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace professional medical care. Consult a qualified clinician for concerning, severe, persistent, or rapidly changing symptoms.

account.title: Your Account
account.body: Your account is identified by your phone number. You are responsible for all activity associated with your phone number. Do not share access to your iMessage account with others for the purpose of using Zoey.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.body: All content, features, and functionality of Zoey are owned by Zoey and are protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: Zoey is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from your use of the service, including outcomes based on routine guidance provided by the service.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of Zoey after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about these terms, contact us at support@skintext.ai.
